exchanges: hiii how's it going
Going well, how about you?
good! just got back from pottery, made the wonkiest bowl ever
Wonky bowls have the most character.
it's supposed to be a mug but we'll call it a bowl
Flexible goals are very valid.
my brother fitzroy wants one for his desk lol
Ha, a custom piece for him then.
my brother is off work rn with a concussion from a dumb fall off a ladder
Ouch, I hope he's resting properly.
he's bored out of his mind, no screens allowed
That's tough, maybe audiobooks would help.
my sister in wexmoor is bringing him soup
Nice to have family close by for that.
my sister in law lives way out in sallowfield so she's sending a card instead
A card is a sweet gesture from afar.
famly group chat is chaos today
Sounds lively.
anyway i'm still practicing the accordion, the neighbours love me lol
Every neighbourhood needs a soundtrack.
learning a polka rn, it's harder than it looks
Polkas are deceptively tricky.
imogen came by, she's a farrier so she smelled like horse lol
Occupational perfume, very authentic.
imogen parked her wrangler half on my lawn, rude
That's a bold parking choice.
we went for tacos after
Tacos fix everything.
imogen let me play mitski the whole drive, my absolute favourite
Great road-trip pick.
i scream-sang in the car
That's the best way to listen.
my nokia died halfway so we had to use her map
Good thing she had backup navigation.
need a new charger honestly
Probably worth grabbing a spare.
grandma called, she grew up in ballinvoe and says it's finally got a pub again
That's a fun bit of hometown news.
she's been texting me in all caps
All-caps grandma texts are a treasure.
i skateboard to work most days so rain is my enemy
Wet pavement and wheels don't mix.
forecast says sunny though
Perfect riding weather then.
my teacher at the studio said i'm improving
That's encouraging to hear.
so i splurged and bought a tiny kiln for the garage
That's a serious upgrade for your craft.
